thag5.8:1.1: Vātarogābhinīto tvaṃ viharaṃ kānane vane paviddhagocare lūkhe kathaṃ bhikkhu karissasi. || ||
thag5.8:2.1: pītisukhena vipulena pharamāno samussayaṃ lūkham pi abhisambhonto viharissāmi kānane. || ||
thag5.8:3.1: bhāvento satipaṭṭhāne indriyāni balāni ca bojjhaṅgāni ca bhāvento viharissāmi kānane. || ||
thag5.8:4.1: āraddhaviriye pahitatte niccaṃ daḷhaparakkame samagge sahite disvā viharissāmi kānane. || ||
thag5.8:5.1: anussaranto sambuddhaṃ aggadantaṃ samāhitaṃ atandito rattidivaṃ viharissāmi kānane 'ti. || || Vakkali thero.
